start.welcome: 🛡️ Commandor Dev Pack — Email Infrastructure Platform ────────────────────────────── High-performance email alias management, subdomains, and cloud routing right inside Telegram. Generate instant aliases, claim custom identities (e.g. name-ca@example.com), receive verification codes in real time, and deploy edge-hosted sites. 📬 EMAIL ACTIONS • /inbox — Incoming mail & instant OTP extraction • /aliases — Manage & toggle active email aliases • /new — Instant disposable address • /custom <name> — Protected custom alias (with -ca) • /burner — 1-hour self-destructing address 🌐 INFRASTRUCTURE & TOOLS • /subdomains — Subdomain routing & reverse proxy • /hosting — Edge cloud hosting & server nodes • /api — REST API keys & developer documentation • /search — Search incoming messages • /web — Web Dashboard with real-time sync • /stats — Account usage & storage metrics • /language — Switch interface language • /help — Complete command guide ────────────────────────────── 👇 Choose an action below to get started:

bot.tos.prompt: ⚖️ Welcome to Commandor Dev Pack ────────────────────────────── To protect the integrity of our edge network, server nodes, and users, you must agree to our Terms of Service before using this bot. 📜 Core Platform Guidelines: 1️⃣ Strict Anti-Abuse: • No phishing kits, malware, ransomware, or botnets. • No abusive scanning, credential stuffing, or exploits. 2️⃣ Responsible Messaging: • Disposable & custom subdomains must not be used for bulk fraud. 3️⃣ Clean Edge Hosting: • Deployed sites are monitored via real-time security scanners. • Crypto miners and attack scripts will be terminated instantly. 4️⃣ Audit Logging & Traceability: • System actions and deployments are logged for platform security. 5️⃣ Zero-Tolerance Violations: • Breaches result in immediate account termination. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ By clicking "Accept Terms", you certify that you have read, understood, and agreed to abide by these guidelines.
bot.email_suite.main_message: 📬 EMAIL SUITE & ALIAS MANAGER ────────────────────────────── Protect your personal inbox, bypass signup gates, and receive verification OTPs in real-time. ⚡ Available Capabilities: • Quick Disposable: Instant 1-click throwaway address. • Custom Alias: Personalized prefix with protected -ca namespace. • 1-Hour Burner: Self-destructing temporary mailbox. • Catch-All Subdomains: Receive emails sent to any address on your subdomains. 📊 Status: {{aliasCount}} active aliases • {{unreadCount}} unread emails ────────────────────────────── Select an action below:
bot.subdomain_hub.main_message: 🌐 SUBDOMAINS & ROUTING HUB ────────────────────────────── Claim custom subdomains under *.example.com with full DNS routing and HTTP proxying. ⚡ Subdomain Modes: • Email Catch-All: *@yoursub.example.com routes to Telegram. • HTTP Webhooks: Capture incoming POST/GET requests in real-time. • Static HTML: Serve custom landing pages. • Reverse Proxy: Forward traffic to your external web servers. 📊 Active Subdomains: {{subCount}} ────────────────────────────── Select an action below:
bot.api_hub.main_message: 🔑 API & DEVELOPER PLATFORM ────────────────────────────── Automate inbox monitoring, alias generation, and subdomain management with our fast REST API. ⚡ Developer Features: • Secure Bearer Tokens: Cryptographically hashed API credentials. • Granular Scopes: Read, write, delete, and admin permissions. • Full REST Endpoints: JSON APIs for all bot capabilities. 📊 Active API Keys: {{keyCount}} ────────────────────────────── Select an action below:
bot.infra_hub.main_message: 🌐 DOMAINS & INFRASTRUCTURE HUB ────────────────────────────── Orchestrate high-speed email routing, custom subdomains, and multi-node cloud hosting. ⚡ Available Capabilities: • Subdomains: Claim custom subdomains with catch-all routing & reverse proxy. • Cloud Hosting: Deploy static HTML or full ZIP websites directly onto edge nodes. • Server Nodes: (Admins) Provision and monitor multi-node SSH server clusters. 📊 Active: {{subCount}} Subdomains • {{siteCount}} Hosted Sites ────────────────────────────── Select an infrastructure action below:
bot.utilities_hub.main_message: ⚙️ UTILITIES & SYSTEM TOOLS ────────────────────────────── Fast access to email burners, full-text message search, account statistics, and platform configuration. ⚡ Available Tools: • 1-Hour Burner: Instant self-destructing throwaway inbox. • Search: Scan incoming messages, sender addresses, and subjects. • Interface Language: Select from 12 natively translated languages. • Usage Stats: Storage, quota limits, and activity metrics. • Help Reference: Complete command list and usage guidelines. ────────────────────────────── Select a tool below:

bot.tos.detailed: 📜 DETAILED TERMS OF SERVICE & ACCEPTABLE USE ────────────────────────────── 1. Acceptance of Terms By interacting with this bot, API, web dashboard, or edge hosting nodes, you legally agree to adhere to these Terms of Service. 2. Acceptable Use Policy You agree to use this platform only for lawful communications, software testing, personal portfolios, and verified development. Strictly Prohibited: • Distribution of malicious software (trojans, worms, ransomware) • Hosting or linking to phishing or fraudulent login pages • Unauthorized vulnerability scanning or DDoS orchestration • Copyright infringement or hosting pirated content • Cryptocurrency mining scripts in any form 3. Service Availability & Quotas We reserve the right to limit, throttle, or suspend accounts that generate anomalous network traffic, overload hosting nodes, or attempt unauthorized privilege escalation. 4. Logging & Security Scanners All deployed files and system actions undergo automatic heuristics and signature checks. Malicious signatures result in immediate blocking and audit logging. 5. Modification of Terms Terms may be updated periodically to reflect security requirements. Continuing to use the bot constitutes acceptance of modified terms. ──────────────────────────────
bot.tos.declined: ❌ Terms of Service Declined You have chosen not to accept the Terms of Service. Platform access remains locked. Whenever you change your mind, tap Accept Terms below or send /start.
bot.privacy_desc: Your privacy is our core engineering requirement: • Zero Plaintext Logging: Incoming messages are encrypted and isolated in storage, bound exclusively to your user identity. • HTML Sanitization: All incoming email HTML is aggressively sanitized. Tracker beacons, malicious scripts, and cross-site requests are stripped. • 1-Hour Burners: Temporary aliases self-destruct automatically when their timer expires. • Data Sovereignty: You can export your data anytime via /export or delete your emails and aliases on demand. • End-to-End Sessions: Web sessions are hashed with SHA-256 and expire automatically. Commandor Dev Pack never sells, rents, or reads your personal communications.
